<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex087042026-02-2316-22-22" status="unreviewed">rtags de dag 'gal ba la brten pas | 'gal pa bshad na 'gal ba'i mtshan nyid | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">kha cig</rs> chos gang zhig gang gis dben pa zhes zer la |
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">gzhan</rs> ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo <lb edRef="inst:5293" n="37b5"/> tsha ba chen po</rs>'i rjes su 'breng nas phan tshun tha dad pa zhes pa dang || gang zhig gang yin par grub pa zhes kyang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">la la</rs> smra'o ||
         dang po ltar na dgag pa'i tha snyad byar rung chos can | byar mi rung dang mi 'gal bar thal | sgrub pa yin pas byar mi rung gis mi dben pa'i phyir | 
         rtags ma grub na byar mi rung du mtshon pa'i mtshan nyid <lb edRef="inst:5293" n="37b6"/> mi rung par thal bar 'gyur na de'ang khyod 'dod pa ma yin no ||</seg></TEI>
